migrate.hubTitle: From a previous agent into Grok Bot
migrate.hubLead: This is not a one-shot dump. Grok Bot receives one packet at a time. Copy the profile, then memory, skills, and routines. This does not move API keys or run Hermes on Grok.
migrate.ruleMemory: Memory is preview-then-confirm. Daily notes and DREAMS are a working layer, so they stay off the queue unless you opt in.
migrate.ruleRoutines: A skill is how; a routine is when. Official order: do the task once → save as a skill → then schedule a routine. Cap 50 routines per Bot. Duplicate Bot does not copy learned memory.
migrate.ruleSecrets: .env, auth.json, apiKey, botToken, SecretRef values, and key-looking strings are always stripped. Sessions, state.db, and transcripts are not memory.
migrate.hermesLead: A profile export (zip/tar.gz) or loose SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and cron.
migrate.hermesPageLead: Hermes profiles become setup text, memory, skill, and routine packets. Always preview, then confirm — like hermes claw migrate. Cron is recreated. Secrets are never taken.
migrate.openclawLead: A ~/.openclaw zip, a workspace, or SOUL.md / AGENTS.md / MEMORY.md / cron.
migrate.openclawPageLead: OpenClaw (or clawdbot/moltbot) workspaces become packets. Markdown only, like Import Memory. Files are not merged blindly into bootstrap MEMORY.md.

accept.hermes: zip/tar.gz profile, or SOUL.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md, memories/*, skills/*/SKILL.md, cron.
accept.openclaw: zip, or SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md, memory/*.md, HEARTBEAT.md, openclaw.json, cron/jobs.json, skills. Legacy clawdbot/moltbot names work.

migrate.includeOptional: Add {count} daily notes / DREAMS to the queue (off by default)
migrate.honesty: This does not move API keys or run {source} on Grok. It hands the next Grok Bot the next piece. Memory, skill, and routine packets are Copy-only into chat. We cannot write xAI memory APIs.
